subject.title: Feature: configurable /new greeting model (or option to suppress greeting)

question: What public reset-start policy should OpenClaw expose for bare `/new` and `/reset` across acknowledgement-only resets, startup/model turns, prompt text, greeting suppression, and optional cheaper greeting-model routing?
rationale: The remaining work adds config and changes session-start/model-routing semantics, so automation should not choose the schema shape or default behavior.

options.title: Add explicit reset-start policy
options.body: Define one typed policy that covers acknowledgement behavior, startup turns, prompt text, suppression, and greeting-model routing while preserving the current default unless maintainers decide otherwise.

options.title: Restore startup turns by default
options.body: Make bare resets run the startup/model turn again and explicitly accept the token-cost, latency, and upgrade behavior change.

options.title: Defer new reset controls
options.body: Keep acknowledgement-only bare resets and leave prompt/fallthrough requests in their narrower trackers until the broader policy is approved.

recommendation.title: Add explicit reset-start policy
recommendation.body: Define one typed policy that covers acknowledgement behavior, startup turns, prompt text, suppression, and greeting-model routing while preserving the current default unless maintainers decide otherwise.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is tied to the current bare reset acknowledgement contract and prior policy review, making it the best available owner for the default/config decision.
